title: Testing bicarbonate–albumin coupling for incremental inflammation-marker prediction across NHANES recruitment waves
abstract: A bicarbonate × albumin product did not establish improved contemporaneous log-CRP prediction beyond flexible routine predictors in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer (5,188 source; 4,675 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.000422 log(mg/L)², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.003715, 0.005462].
